name: Bulk Create Inventories
description: Create inventory items in bulk. Returns a JobId that can be used to retrieve the results of the bulk creation.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Array of inventory objects to create in bulk

attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual inventory items in the bulk creation. Must be unique within the request.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The name of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Cost
attributes.description: The cost of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: The current quantity of the inventory item.

attributes.name: LocationId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the inventory location where this item is stored.

attributes.name: Reorder
attributes.description: The quantity threshold at which the inventory item should be reordered.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief summary or description of the inventory item.

attributes.name: PartNumber
attributes.description: The part number of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Shelf
attributes.description: The shelf or bin location where the inventory item is stored.

attributes.name: Category
attributes.description: The category of the inventory item. If the category does not exist it will be created.

attributes.name: VendorId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the vendor associated with the inventory item.

attributes.name: GlAccountId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account associated with the inventory item.

attributes.name: MarkUpType
attributes.description: The type of markup applied to the inventory item. Valid values are Percentage or Fixed Amount. Required when MarkUp is provided.

attributes.name: MarkUp
attributes.description: The markup value applied to the inventory item.

responseFields.name: JobId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the bulk creation job, used to retrieve the results
